# Chip

A filter that toggles (aria-pressed), or a marker of the current item.

- Status: implemented
- Category: selection
- Pattern: WAI-ARIA APG “button”; HTML `<button aria-pressed> or <a aria-current>`
- Text style: `label` (`.nd-text-label`)

## Anatomy

- **container**: Pill, minimum target height.
- **check** (optional): Shown when pressed or current.
- **label**: Short.

## Variants

- `filter`: Toggles a filter.
- `current`: Marks the current item in a set of links.

## States

- `default`
- `hover`
- `focus-visible`
- `selected`: A check and a 2 px edge; not colour alone.
- `disabled`: Dashed edge.

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Enter, Space | Toggles a filter. |

## Accessibility

- Role: button with aria-pressed, or link with aria-current
- Name: Its label.
- A group of filters sits in a group with a label.

WCAG 2.2 success criteria:

- 1.4.1 Use of Color (A)
- 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast (AA)
- 2.4.7 Focus Visible (AA)
- 2.4.13 Focus Appearance (AAA)
- 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum) (AA)
- 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (A)

## Web example

From the reference page:

```html
<div class="nd-cluster" role="group" aria-label="Filters">
  <button type="button" class="nd-chip" aria-pressed="true">Selected</button>
  <button type="button" class="nd-chip" aria-pressed="false">Filter</button>
  <button type="button" class="nd-chip" disabled>Disabled</button>
</div>
```
